about: Per-place district week and interim committee day for the state officeholder's day, read by office-day-state.ts in place of a global default. The week comes from the place's own regular-session length in data/research/laws/state-session-calendars.json (2026 windows). The interim committee day is the average (no place's own interim schedule is in the repository; see pool item office-interim-committee-schedules).
